auth.invalid_credentials: AUX rejected the email address or password. Automatic login has stopped. Check your AUX account and use Repair in this device's settings to sign in again. Use a separate AUX guest account for Homey when also using AC Freedom/AUX Home.
auth.locked: AUX has temporarily locked this account. Automatic login has stopped. Wait at least 10 minutes without login attempts, then use Repair in this device's settings to sign in again. Use a separate AUX guest account for Homey when also using the phone app.
auth.lock_warning: AUX warns that further failed logins may lock this account. Automatic login has stopped. Wait at least 10 minutes without login attempts, check your credentials, then use Repair. Use a separate AUX guest account for Homey when also using the phone app.
auth.login_failed: Automatic login is paused after an AUX login problem. Check your account, then use Repair in this device's settings to sign in again. Use a separate AUX guest account for Homey when also using AC Freedom/AUX Home.
auth.enter_credentials: Enter the email address and password of your AUX account.
auth.device_not_shared: This air conditioner is not visible to this AUX account. Share it with your AUX guest account in AC Freedom/AUX Home, accept the invitation if required, and try again. Your saved device has not been replaced.
auth.no_devices: No air conditioners were found. First set up your air conditioner in AC Freedom/AUX Home and share it with your AUX guest account. Older models and cloud accounts may not be compatible.
auth.unreachable: The AUX cloud could not be reached or the air conditioner could not be read. Homey will retry automatically.
auth.repairing: Signing in again. Please wait until repair is complete.

account.title: Before signing in
account.compatibility: Your air conditioner must already work in AC Freedom or AUX Home. Tested with one AUX Freedom 5.0 kW unit; other models and older accounts may not work. Internet access is required.
account.guest_title: Use a separate AUX guest account
account.guest: To use Homey and the phone app together, create a second AUX account with its own email address and password. Share your air conditioner with it in AC Freedom/AUX Home and accept the invitation if required. Check that the guest can see the air conditioner.
account.signin: Sign into Homey with the AUX guest account. Keep your main account in the phone app: using the same account in both can disconnect Homey. This is an AUX account, not a Homey guest user.
account.repair: Already added this air conditioner? Signing in through Repair keeps your device and Flows. After an account lockout or warning, wait at least 10 minutes without login attempts before continuing.
